title: Save New Examples for Testing
outcome: By the end, I can freeze a model before labels are revealed and report a bounded test result.
scenario: A fictional envelope exercise evaluates a fixed pencil-length sorter.
given: Freeze PencilP: long at least 6 cm; short below 6.
Reserved valid lengths are 3,5,6,9 cm. Teacher envelope labels, revealed only after predictions, are short,long,long,long.

steps.label: Freeze
steps.detail: Write PencilP and its boundary before opening the label envelope.

steps.label: Compare
steps.detail: Three of four agree; the disagreement is at 5 cm.

explanation: The prediction record must exist before the labels are seen. PencilP scores 3/4=75% agreement on these four selected cases. Moving the boundary after inspecting the envelope makes this a development exercise; the same four cases can no longer serve as untouched final evaluation.

counterfactual.change: After feedback, change the boundary to 5.
counterfactual.prediction: The revised rule matches all four known labels but needs a different final test.
counterfactual.reason: These labels influenced the revision, so replaying them is evidence of repair rather than unseen performance.

student_task: Does 4/4 on the replay replace the original 3/4 result? Explain.
teacher_answer: No. Keep 3/4 as the frozen version’s result; record 4/4 separately as a revised-version replay on known cases.
project_evidence: Maintain dated sorter versions and separate development examples from reserved project-evaluation cases.
limits: Four selected cases cannot establish a reliable accuracy rate for every future pencil or classroom.
review_note: New fictional worked case reviewed against the weekly topic and reserved independent assessment. Keep that assessment separate; this picture is supported practice.
